name: teamcity-mcp
description: TeamCity CI/CD over MCP: the full REST API — trigger and monitor builds, tail build logs, inspect test failures, manage the queue, projects, build configs, agents, mutes, and investigations.

teamcity_url.title: TeamCity URL
teamcity_url.description: Base URL of your TeamCity server, e.g. https://teamcity.example.com

teamcity_token.title: Access Token (recommended)
teamcity_token.description: Personal access token from TeamCity → Profile → Access Tokens. Leave empty to use basic auth below.

teamcity_username.title: Username (basic auth)
teamcity_username.description: Only used when no access token is set.

teamcity_password.title: Password (basic auth)
teamcity_password.description: Only used when no access token is set.
